prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: diffuse/albedo material atlas for a real 3D Pombero folklore model in Caelum Argenteum, an Argentine nineteenth-century dark fantasy game. Create a square 1024x1024 opaque atlas filling every pixel, EXACTLY TWO EQUAL COLUMNS AND FOUR EQUAL ROWS, eight flat rectangular material swatches, with boundaries exactly at half width and quarter heights. No gutters, labels, borders or text. Each swatch is a uniform finely detailed material, viewed straight on, with neutral diffuse lighting and no directional shadows. Row1 left: mature warm tan skin with subtle pores and mottling, no anatomical features; row1 right: the same warm tan skin densely covered in fine short dark brown body hair. Row2 left: weathered warm ivory coarse linen for a loose rural shirt; row2 right: dark umber rough burlap for a worn waistcoat and trousers. Row3 left: golden sun-faded plaited straw for a rural broad-brim hat; row3 right: long dark chestnut-brown hair strands running mainly vertically with slight irregular waviness. Row4 left: reddish-brown coarse braided rope fibers, a flat close view with no large rope silhouette or knots; row4 right: very dark brown matte worn leather with subtle grain for small details. Preserve these restrained earth colors, painterly modeled material detail appropriate to an older dark fantasy game, readable rather than glossy. Each panel must have a consistent fine material scale and no large focal element. The eight materials are drawn from an inspected approved concept: a short stocky hairy forest goblin with pointed ears, a straw hat, ivory shirt, brown vest and trousers, and a rope belt. Do NOT depict the character, face, eyes, ears, limbs, clothing objects, seams, buttons, isolated objects, scenery, a 3D render, gradients of lighting, logos or watermarks. This is only a flat material sheet; mesh, anatomy and visual approval are separate.
status: Material atlas only; no model or author acceptance inferred.
